snippet.title: Gigantes Ex Machina – Official Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The battlefield just evolved.  
Gigantes Ex Machina launches in Early Access on August 5 (UTC) with expanded content, new weapons, and devastating mechs.  
Get ready to pilot your own mechanical monster in this explosive tactical action game.

Wishlist Now on STEAM:
